product.name: Loom
product.lede: Loom is the runtime for governed agents. It makes a model behave like an agent for one bounded run, and the model acts only through actions the current frontier admits. Commission's runtime, the Canon governor and intake live here too: b10x-loom run takes an intent to a governed run that stops at the merge, and b10x-loom-sdk embeds the same runtime in an application.
product.meta: Rust workspace · b10x-loom CLI and b10x-loom-sdk · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

sections.title: Governed reach, not a bigger tool list.
sections.lede: What a model can do in a run is derived from the frontier, never from what was registered at startup. A selector can be wrong about which admissible action is best. It cannot produce an action the frontier does not contain.

items.title: Selections stay inside the frontier
items.description: Every selection goes to Commission's admission check. One it refuses, such as an action outside the frontier, is never proposed, whatever the selector reported.

items.title: Loom proposes, Commission invokes
items.description: A step ends at a ProposedAction. The Commission runtime rechecks frontier, case revision and authority, then hands it to an effect port (Atlas ADR 0082).

items.title: Evidence from a verifier, never a model
items.description: The slice submits evidence only from the exit status of the test command it ran itself. Nothing a model says becomes evidence.

items.title: Selection apart from arguments
items.description: A fast typed selector picks the action; the reasoning model fills in that action's arguments only. Low confidence falls back to a stronger path.

sections.title: Five steps, two owners.
sections.lede: The first three steps are Loom's. The last two belong to the Commission runtime. All five run today; the status below says what is still planned.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Project the catalogue
steps.description: The frontier's admissible actions become what the model may see.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Select one action
steps.description: A reasoning model, a rule or a fast typed selector picks from those candidates only.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Generate its arguments
steps.description: For the selected action only, validated against its schema.

steps.label: Commission
steps.title: Revalidate
steps.description: Against the current frontier, case revision and authority.

steps.label: Commission
steps.title: Invoke the effect
steps.description: Through the effect port the embedder supplies.

sections.title: What Loom is specified in.
sections.lede: The loom.run domain of Loom's ESS specification: a session owns its turns, a turn owns the catalogue projected for it, a selection names one action from that catalogue, and arguments are requested for that selection only. Generated from ess/ by loom-docs.

sections.title: Early. Here is exactly what exists.
sections.lede: Shipped means code on main today. Decided means recorded in an architecture decision. Planned means on the plan only. Nothing is released yet.
